newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Waterford boards not endorsing Avonmore proposal.
newsitem.headline: Waterford boards not endorsing Avonmore proposal.

text.p: The boards of Waterford Foods Plc and Waterford Co-operative Society Limited said they could not endorse a recent merger proposal from Avonmore Foods Plc as it did not reflect the underlying value of the Waterford business.

"It does not reflect the underlying value of the Waterford business, its strategic positioning in key markets and the contribution it can make to any merged entity in the future," a statement from the two boards said.
But they said they agreed with the concept of merger or industry consolidation to increase shareholder value and secure the best future for all its stakeholders.
"In this regard, operational scale and strategic positioning will be critical factors in any evaluation process," the statement said.
"In this context, if Avonmore sees fit to make an equitable proposal it will, in the interest of all the stakeholders in Waterford, be considered by the boards of the company and society."
The statement followed a meeting on Friday of the two boards to consider the Avonmore offer which would have created a merged entity with turnover in excess of 2.5 billion Irish pounds.
